title: Exact-Revision Recorded Held-Capacity Commitment Read
purpose: Read the total quantity of durable held reservation rows recorded against one exact SKU capacity-source revision or one exact fulfillment-slot capacity-source revision.
dependencies: FOOD-005T capacity supply and reservation storage schema
FOOD-005U capacity revision provenance schema amendment

storage.immutability: Migration 0003 prohibits updates and deletes on reservation, reservation-line, and fulfillment-slot reservation rows.

sku.selector: exact SKU id/version plus exact capacity-source revision

slot.selector: exact fulfillment method/location/window plus exact slot capacity-source revision

queries.sku: Sum food_capacity_reservation_lines.quantity joined to food_capacity_reservations where parent state is held and sku_id, sku_version, capacity_revision exactly match the selector.
queries.slot: Sum food_fulfillment_slot_reservations.quantity joined to food_capacity_reservations where parent state is held and method, location_reference, window_reference, capacity_revision exactly match the selector.

zeroSemantics: No matching recorded held rows returns recordedHeldQuantity zero. Zero is not absence of physical stock, not proof of availability, and not reservation acceptance.

outcomes.read: A structurally valid nonnegative safe-integer aggregate was returned.
outcomes.invalid: The selector is structurally invalid; no database access occurs.
outcomes.storage-failure: Preparation, binding, execution, result-envelope validation, aggregate-row validation, or numeric validation failed.

safeClaim: Stored held reservation rows recorded against the requested exact capacity-source revision sum to the returned recordedHeldQuantity.
concurrency: The result is a read-time aggregate under the injected database/session semantics only. Later inserts may occur immediately after the read.
crossRevisionBoundary: FOOD-007J does not roll a commitment recorded against one capacity-source revision into any other revision.
lifecycleBoundary: Migration 0003 supports held only. FOOD-007J does not infer current active status after any future release, cancellation, expiration, replacement, rescheduling, or consumption lifecycle is introduced.
acceptanceBoundary: FOOD-007J does not create, require, validate, or infer FOOD-005L reservation acceptance.
physicalInventoryBoundary: Reservation holds are not physical inventory movements and FOOD-007J does not establish physical quantity on hand.
sideEffects: Read-only server-library export. No writes, routes, clocks, environment access, network access, randomness, acceptance construction, migration execution, or production mutation.
